title: Curry Banana Tempura
description: A unique Japanese dessert, combining the sweetness of bananas with the spiciness of curry. Perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Peel the bananas and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, curry powder, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate dish, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Dip each banana piece into the egg wash, then coat in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Fry the banana pieces in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the tempura on paper towels.
Dust the tempura with granulated sugar and a pinch of curry powder.
